verdict.rationale: Raygun documents deployment tracking to spot new errors and regressions, a Deployments API, per-error version data with version filtering, and native GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab repo integrations, so errors can be tied to releases. Nothing in the evidence shows a per-issue "first seen in release" field or suspect-commit attribution. Missing for 10: explicit first-appeared-in-release display on each issue, suspect commit identification, documentation of how commits link to error groups, independent or hands-on corroboration.
